newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade to redeem Series G preferred.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade to redeem Series G preferred.

text.p: Boise Cascade Corp on Friday said it will redeem its series G conversion preferred stock, and the related $1.58 depositary shares, on July 15.

Each depositary share represents one-tenth of a share of the Series G preferred stock. In exchange for each depositary share, the holders will receive 0.63 share of common stock plus cash for fractional shares, Boise Cascade said.

Series G and depositary shareholders may elect to convert depositary shares to Boise Cascade common stock before the end of business on July 15 at a rate of 0.801 share of common stock for each depositary share.

On April 18, Boise Cascade declared a $3.95 per share dividend on the Series G stock, which is equivalent to $0.395 per depositary share, payable on July 15, to holders of record on July 1. Stock and despoistary shareholders who redeem their holdings on July 15 or convert after July 1 will receive the dividend.
